exercises.why: The perfective деепричастие is formed from the masculine past tense of the perfective verb by replacing -л with -в or -вши (the -вши form is becoming more and more obsolete): написал — написав (написавши); получил — получив (получивши). — DLI, Lessons 101–103.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
